A previous session on this branch already produced one anchor commit (660556a75a9d2abb44975f6617a279c9b2a1f37c, 'anchor seam extraction') that did the bulk of the assistant-provider, command-routing, and setter-injection extraction described in the task brief. summary: Extracted the persona-fleet-projection implementation and the management-AI-conversation/audit route handlers that were still only assembled inside main.py so they are live-wired defaults reachable via core.app_factory.compose_bff_app() without importing main.py. Fixed a bug where compose_bff_app() silently replaced any pre-wired assistant control-mode store with a fresh empty one on every call (breaking any test/caller that had already set one). Fixed an infinite-recursion bug introduced by naively re-injecting main.py's own re-exported dispatcher wrapper for _project_persona_fleet_item / _project_operator_runtime_state_row back into wire_management_runtime_projections as if it were a distinct override implementation. Closed dev's own documented 'genuine blocker' (test_assistant_provider_usage_summary_aggregates_history_and_quota needing main.py because the usage-summary route had no seam) as a byproduct of moving that route handler to management_service.py.

recursion_bug_found_and_fixed.symptom: RecursionError: maximum recursion depth exceeded, raised from assistant/management_service.py's _project_persona_fleet_item wrapper calling itself via get_project_persona_fleet_item(), surfaced by dev's test_management_nl_persona_fleet_summary_includes_health_items (use_real_main=True) and reachable the same way through _project_operator_runtime_state_row.
recursion_bug_found_and_fixed.root_cause: main.py's own module-scope wire_management_runtime_projections(...) call was passing project_persona_fleet_item=_project_persona_fleet_item and project_operator_runtime_state_row=_project_operator_runtime_state_row, where those two names in main.py's namespace are themselves just imports of management_service.py's *dispatcher* functions (the ones that read the current override and call it), not the real implementations. Once main.py loaded and ran its wiring call, it self-assigned each dispatcher as its own override, so the very next call recursed into itself.
recursion_bug_found_and_fixed.fix: Removed both kwargs (and their now-unused imports) from main.py's wire_management_runtime_projections(...) call; the already-correct impl-backed defaults (_project_persona_fleet_item_impl, _project_operator_runtime_state_row_impl) are used automatically when no override is supplied, which is the correct behavior now that main.py has no implementation of its own left to inject.
recursion_bug_found_and_fixed.verification: test_management_nl_persona_fleet_summary_includes_health_items and the full test_management_nl_assistant_provider.py suite pass after the fix; grep confirms main.py no longer references _project_persona_fleet_item, _project_operator_runtime_state_row, _persona_fleet_runtime_matches, or _project_persona_fleet_health anywhere.
